text: Think WW2 soldiers spent all day storming beaches and winning battles? Yeah... not even close.
Most of the time, being a soldier was basically digging holes and waiting.
They dug foxholes. Fall asleep on watch? Congratulations. You're everyone's least favorite soldier.
And the food? Canned meat and biscuits. Dry socks? A luxury.
But when the shooting started? EVERYTHING changed. Helmets on, heads down, hoping the next shell missed.
Win, and you got rest, letters, and a hot meal. Lose, and it ended VERY badly.
So yeah, soldier life was mostly digging and waiting... with occasional chaos.
